title: One file. From single node to HA cluster.
ledeHtml: Most PaaS platforms cap at vertical scaling — when you grow, you migrate. Most Kubernetes distros assume you're starting big. AppRafter is the same platform from a €5 VPS to a multi-node HA cluster, and the same Application.cue deploys to both.

leftStage.caption: A single VDS. Single-node Postgres. SealedSecrets. Sane defaults.

rightStage.caption: 3+ nodes. CloudNativePG. Replayable audit log. OpenBao for secrets.

caveatHtml: Today: Tier 1 and Tier 2 ready at signup. T1→T2 migration tool ships in the first post-launch bundle (~2–4 weeks after release).
